packageRules.description: Use version tags for GitHub-authored actions; retain digest pinning for third-party actions.
led-image-api carries the gRPC bindings shared with led-service2, so a bump must be checked against the version actually deployed on the device.
The bundled display font is pinned by two SHA-256 checksums Renovate cannot recompute, so the version bump alone leaves the build failing until they are refreshed.
prBodyNotes: Refresh `FONT_SHA256` and `LICENSE_SHA256` in the `Dockerfile` before merging. `docker build` fails on a mismatch, so an unrefreshed bump cannot reach the registry.

packageRules.description: Mark major updates for manual review.

customManagers.description: Display font pinned in the Dockerfile; the release tags are not strict semver.
